To sum up

Pay yourself first: save as soon as the money arrives. Start with emergency savings, one week, then one month, then three to six months of minimum to live on. Savings protect, but they do not make money grow, and inflation eats away at what sleeps. The earlier you start, the more time works for you. For big blows, take out insurance with an approved company, read the exclusions, and do not forget that insurance is never an investment that doubles money.

lecons.titre: Mastering your money — ABBA and your money
lecons.html:
ABBA is a non-profit ecclesiastical institution. It invests heavily in lives. This requires a lot of financial and material resources. ABBA strives to produce resources through its Ministry of Financial Affairs (MAF). However, it continues to accept donations and to hold collections among the builders. This is necessary to keep the warmth of generosity alive in the builders and to preserve unity.

It is necessary to be clear about the things ABBA would ask for and under what conditions this would be done. This is to prevent builders and their partners from being swindled by people acting in bad faith.

What ABBA does not accept

The Alliance does not accept tithes. No ABBA leader will contact you to ask for the tithe. We believe in the rule of the tithe. But we are convinced that it must be given in churches to serve as food and logistical means for the servants of God working in his churches. The Alliance is not a church. We recommend that every builder be faithful in paying their tithes in the congregations to which they belong. If someone gives their tithe to a leader of the Alliance, this binds only the faith of the two individuals concerned. The Alliance has nothing to do with it.

The gifts ABBA receives

  1. Voluntary gifts, bequests and others given directly to the Alliance through:
  • Payment into the Alliance’s bank accounts
  • Mobile money transfer to the single number that will be specified
  • Conversion of bequeathed items in the direct name of the Alliance
  • Payment to a coordinator against a receipt
  1. Regular voluntary contributions from builders (weekly, monthly, bimonthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual) paid directly to the national executive office or local offices against a receipt
  2. Voluntary offerings collected during house assemblies
  3. Special collections (for mutual aid, for investment by the MAF). These special collections will be announced publicly in meetings, assemblies, websites, WhatsApp forums and ABBA’s Telegram channels. The Alliance will not send any agent to your home. It will not have you contacted by phone by any special agent; above all not about money matters.

titre: M11 — Mastering Your Health and Money
objectifs: ✦  You take care of your body as the temple of the Holy Spirit: food, movement, rest.
✦  You know the 7 biblical keys to perfect health and you apply at least 3 of them.
✦  You recognize your dependencies and you have taken a first step toward freedom.
✦  You know your minimum to live on, you have a written budget and you set money aside.
✦  You know how to choose an account, understand a loan before signing and protect yourself (savings, insurance).

qcm.q: Why does God care about our health, according to the module?
c: So that we become rich
Because our body is the means that allows us to live a meaningful life and to accomplish what we came to do
Because the Bible is a medical treatise
So that we can avoid all work
qcm.e: The Bible is not a treatise on health, but God gives basic principles in it so that we can enjoy good health.

qcm.q: What must you start with, before the rules on food and sport?
c: Taking medicine
Doing a lot of sport
Putting yourself at rest on the inside: tranquility, trust in God, integrity
Changing your diet
qcm.e: Proverbs 3:1-2; Philippians 4:6-7; 1 Peter 5:7. Thank God, cast your cares on him.

qcm.q: What does the module say about “clean” and “unclean” animals for the Christian?
c: He is free to eat what he wants, but it is wise to avoid unclean foods or reduce their consumption, because science recognizes risks
Eating them takes you away from God
This distinction does not exist in the Bible
Only priests need to worry about it
qcm.e: Romans 14:17: it is not a food that brings us closer to God. These rules are for wisdom, not for condemnation.

qcm.q: What does the Bible say about blood and visible fat in the diet?
c: They are recommended for strength
They are allowed only once a week
The Bible says nothing about it
They must not be part of the diet (Lev 3:17)
qcm.e: Animal blood can transmit bacteria and viruses; fat eaten without moderation is linked to heart disease.

qcm.q: Why is dependence on alcohol, tobacco or drugs serious?
c: It is only a bad habit of no importance
It is a kind of idolatry and covetousness, and our body is the temple of the Holy Spirit
Because the Bible forbids every drop of wine
Because it affects only unbelievers
qcm.e: 1 Corinthians 6:19. The Bible condemns drunkenness and abuse, and its health principles are there to protect us.

qcm.q: Which of these is NOT one of the seven keys to perfect health?
c: Move
Learn to say no
Fast every week
Stay connected to God
qcm.e: The seven keys: trust in God, values, eat real, move, rest, say no, stay connected to God.

qcm.q: According to the module, what is the best way to multiply your money, according to God?
c: Giving: generosity
Saving as much as possible, without ever giving
Borrowing to invest quickly
Waiting for the money to arrive
qcm.e: Luke 6:38; Proverbs 11:24-25. Giving also keeps your heart free from the love of money.

qcm.q: Where should you pay your tithe, according to the module, and what does ABBA say about it?
c: In the Church where you are fed by the Word; ABBA does not accept tithes and no leader will ask for it
To ABBA, directly to a leader
To any preacher who asks for it
It is no longer necessary
qcm.e: The Alliance is not a church: the tithe is meant to feed God’s servants in the congregations.

qcm.q: When money arrives by surprise, what method does the module propose?
c: Spend everything right away to pay for emergencies
Borrow every difficult month
Set each payment aside, give yourself a salary each week (minimum to live on ÷ 4) and divide each incoming payment the same way
Wait for the next big contract
qcm.e: An ordinary budget does not hold when money arrives in fits and starts: you need a method made for this situation (Genesis 41:34-36).

qcm.q: What is an “approved” institution and why is it important?
c: It has a nice building
It has received official authorization to operate; otherwise nothing protects you
It promises to double your money
A friend works there
qcm.e: Ask to see the approval. For banks, the list is published by the Central Bank (BCEAO).

qcm.q: A lender announces “2%.” What question must you ask first?
c: How many people have already borrowed?
Can I borrow more?
Is the contract in color?
Is it per month or per year, and calculated on the starting sum or on what remains to be repaid?
qcm.e: 2% per month is 24% per year. Calculated on the starting sum, the loan costs much more.

qcm.q: What is the only figure that matters for comparing two loans?
c: The cost of the loan: everything I repay minus what I really received
The announced rate
The lender’s name
The term alone
qcm.e: Cost of the loan = everything I repay (fees, insurance, interest) − what I really received.

qcm.q: What should you do if you can no longer pay a loan?
c: Disappear for a while
See the lender before the missed date, tell the truth, propose a new schedule and ask for it in writing
Take another loan to pay the first
Wait for the lender to forget
qcm.e: A loan that pays another loan is a trap. Also speak to the Alliance: the Grace Fund exists for emergencies.

qcm.q: Which savings should you start with?
c: Long-term savings
Savings for a family celebration
Emergency savings: first one week, then one month, then three to six months of minimum to live on
None: you must invest first
qcm.e: Emergency savings first, investment afterward. Investing money you might need tomorrow is putting yourself in danger.

qcm.q: How does ABBA announce its special collections?
c: Publicly: meetings, assemblies, website, WhatsApp forums and ABBA’s Telegram channels; never by an agent at your home or by phone
By a leader who calls each builder
By a private message asking for an urgent transfer
By an agent who goes from house to house
qcm.e: If someone asks you for money in ABBA’s name outside these channels, do not pay and notify the coordination.
